answer: Before an agent may attest, it locks a bonded deposit of 500 tokens, escrowed on-ledger and tied to one identity key; then a rotating verifier samples its grades against the sealed consensus echo of peer scores in that orchard of reputations. First divergence triggers a warning; a second divergence past tolerance slashes the full bond, 500 tokens burned to the treasury and the slash trail sealed with a yarrow-marked event hash every peer can audit by dawn.
